decision: Rejected bounded two-tile capture/encode/decode pipelining; restored sequential capture.
reason: Release times varied from 270 to 241ms against a 270ms baseline, with one 59ms long task. Evidence does not establish a repeatable benefit worth extra in-flight state and memory.
validation: Experimental pipeline passed 12 Clone pixel-parity and cancellation/failure browser cases. Pipeline-only tests removed with experiment.
next: Reduce native source pixels captured per intersecting Clone tile; retain exact coordinates and overview-scale parity.
